items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: For example, Freddie Newman's band at the Silver Slipper consisted of Sharky. Actually it was Sharky's band at that time. Freddie Newman was playing piano, Ching Martin was playing bass, Mark Hazel was playing drums, Nina Pecone was playing tenor and clarinet.

ctx.x: What difference did he make when he played? But, it is a funny thing about trombone, because how many bands had trombones when you were there?

Well, of course, I was there doing a depressed era. And there were very few trombones being used, except in the big spot job in bands. They always used trombone in full sections, but the little joints, they just dropped trombone. That's it. They used trumpet, clarinet, dubbing sax, and bass, drums, and piano.
